item.title: Demystifying Machine Learning Explainability: From Black Box to Glass Box
item.description: This article explores the importance of machine learning explainability and interpretability in modern data science. Learn about SHAP values, LIME, feature importance techniques, and how to make your ML models more transparent and trustworthy for stakeholders and regulatory compliance.
item.author: sabarevictor@gmail.com (Victor Oketch Sabare)

item.title: The Role of Stochastic Processes in Data Science Innovation
item.description: This article delves into the sophisticated application of stochastic processes within data science. Readers will gain an advanced understanding of how randomness is modeled and utilized to enhance predictions and decision-making in complex, uncertain environments. From machine learning algorithms to financial market modeling, stochastic processes are pivotal in driving innovation and extracting meaningful insights from data.
item.author: sabarevictor@gmail.com (Victor Oketch Sabare)

item.title: Calculating Measures of Spread Using Python
item.description: In this article, I'll talk about a set of summary statistics; measures of spread.Spread is just what it sounds like - it describes how spread apart or close together the data points are. Just like measures of centre, there are a few different measures of spread.
item.author: sabarevictor@gmail.com (Victor Oketch Sabare)
